title: Office Storage Key

sources.title: Basilisk Gate Barracks
markers: both can be opened with the

summary: Opens both heavy chests in the Basilisk Gate Barracks prison office.

fields.Use: Unlock the two office chests with this key. The larger chest can also be lockpicked at DC 18 and the smaller at DC 20. They hold random arrows and scrolls.
fields.Acquisition: Pickpocket Liara Portyr at the Basilisk Gate Barracks.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
